results_section.evidence: candidate_selection_data.csv has 80 LLM catalysts (50 HEA + 30 DA) with delta_e_noh_ev ranging from -0.129 to 1.626 eV (mean 0.774). Only 2/80 (2.5%) fall within 0.15eV of 1.6eV — not the claimed 78%. No Known catalysts exist in the CSV at all, making the 31% comparison unverifiable. No combination of threshold values produces 78% for LLM catalysts; the maximum achievable is 26.2% (at 0.8eV optimal). | Code: code_data/candidate_selection_data.csv (delta_e_noh_ev column); code_data/visualize_candidate_selection.py
